name: The Demon Inside You
source:
Things are not going well in the kingdom of Ustaria. Of late, King Ansellus—known throughout the lands as a just and kind ruler—has become a bloodthirsty tyrant, behaving erratically and sending scores of his subjects to meaningless deaths.

His behavior has shocked everyone, but few more than Serrill, a powerful mage, one of the kingdom's most accomplished exorcists, and Ansellus' long-ago lover. Serrill is confident that Ansellus is no longer himself—so confident that he's taken it upon himself to go on a one-man mission to save him.

Only one thing is certain: Serrill's life will be forever changed.

[From [url=https://natashaluna.itch.io/the-demon-inside-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
乌斯塔利亚王国的情况并不顺利。最近，安塞勒斯国王——举世闻名的公正和仁慈的统治者——变成了一个嗜血的暴君，行为古怪，导致数十名臣民毫无意义地死亡。

他的行为震惊了所有人，但没有人比塞里尔更震惊，他是一位强大的法师，王国最有成就的驱魔师之一，也是安塞勒斯很久以前的情人。塞里尔确信安塞勒斯不再是他自己了——如此自信以至于他独自承担起拯救他的任务。

只有一件事是确定的：塞里尔的生活将永远改变。

[来自[url=https://natashaluna.itch.io/the-demon-inside-you]itch.io[/url]]
